product_goal: Publish one accurate, source-grounded, attention-efficient daily Taiwan public-interest story per Meta platform.

recovery.purpose: Mac-independent Taiwan public-interest daily that earns attention with a verified consequence, then earns trust with named evidence and an explicit fact-versus-interpretation boundary.

threads.metric_note: Median latest-snapshot views across 102 historical posts; API coverage usable.

facebook.metric_note: 126 of 127 legacy samples contain API error markers; measurement-first.

instagram.metric_note: Legacy distribution signal is near zero; carousel format experiment first.

editorial_policy.audience: People in Taiwan who need to understand how politics, food safety, public policy, markets, and the economy affect their money, safety, rights, and daily life.
editorial_policy.required_relevance: The source or proposed post must make a concrete Taiwan connection. Owner submissions remain eligible but still pass every quality gate.
editorial_policy.political_standard: Apply the same evidence, attribution, response, and correction standard to every party and public official.

threads.evidence: Historical morning samples are confounded by prior high cadence; test as a new one-post daily cohort.

facebook.evidence: Legacy Facebook Insights are invalid for 126 of 127 samples; measurement-first experiment.

instagram.evidence: Legacy reach is near zero; test platform-native evidence cards after the evening commute.

timing_experiments.frequency_change: Facebook and Instagram move from two posts per week to one post per day by explicit owner direction; Threads remains one per day.
timing_experiments.decision_gate: Do not change a platform slot or exceed one post per day until at least 7 posts on that platform complete 168h measurement.
